title: The duality conjecture for metric entropy
description: OpenAI's counterexample (2026) to the duality conjecture for metric entropy, posed by Pietsch in 1972: covering numbers of convex bodies are not preserved by polarity up to universal constants, already when one body is a cube. The course turns a real matrix into a pair of bodies, proves the duality theorem for convexified packing, approximates all column combinations of a matrix built from partitions by a short list, and constructs the partitions from random directions for symmetric multilinear forms over a finite field.
prerequisites: foundations-of-von-neumann-algebras lesson hahn-banach-baire-and-the-basic-theorems-on-banach-spaces (Theorems 6.2 and 6.3, separation of convex sets, used in R^n)
